howItWorks.heading: Clear workflows for every cooperative role
howItWorks.quickRuleText: ৳5,000/share monthly due by the 10th · 0% Qard Hasan requires 2/3 member vote · ৳50 late fees go to annual Sadaqah.

member.label: Members
member.headline: Everyday workflow for verified cooperative shareholders
member.s1Summary: Submit your application on Join Amanah with NID, nominee details, portrait photo, and an existing member reference.
member.s2Summary: Deposit ৳5,000 per share by the 10th via Bank or MFS, then upload the receipt or transaction ID in Contributions.
member.s3Summary: Apply for a 0% interest loan (up to ৳50,000 or 75% of your savings) and submit monthly installments over up to 10 months.
member.s4Summary: Cast secret 2/3 ballots on loan requests and Halal ventures in Voting, and message verified peers in Community.

manager.label: Shura Managers
manager.headline: Operational oversight for elected 5-member Shura managers
manager.s1Summary: Inspect incoming Bank/MFS deposit slips and installment payments in Manager Desk before crediting member savings.
manager.s2Summary: Review pending Qard Hasan applications against liquidity limits and launch secret voting for active members.
manager.s3Summary: Close voting once quorum is met, reveal anonymized tallies, and record disbursement proof for approved loans.
manager.s4Summary: Publish Halal investment proposals for 2/3 voting, create community polls, and sync Shura meeting notices.

admin.label: Administrators
admin.headline: System administration, KYC approval, and constitution custody
admin.s1Summary: Verify NIDs, nominee shares, portrait uploads, and reference checks in Users & Roles before issuing Member ID & Activation OTP.
admin.s2Summary: Configure monthly contribution rates, late fees, loan caps, maturity date, and member roles in Site Settings.
admin.s3Summary: Upload the signed cooperative constitution PDF in Site Settings so all visitors and members can view or download it.
admin.s4Summary: Verify the SHA-256 audit log chain, mirror treasury tabs to Google Sheets, and export periodic financial reports.

about.heading: Interest-free mutual relief today, VISION-36 Halal assets by 2036
about.subheading: Amanah combines dual-committee Islamic governance with AES-256-GCM field encryption and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logs.
about.p1Desc: Applicants submit KYC details, nominee NID, portrait photo, existing member reference, and a ৳200 fee into a queue capped at 20 shares.
about.p2Desc: Separation of duties across Shura Management (loan review and monthly updates), Savings Accounts (joint custody), and verified Members.
about.p3Desc: Sensitive KYC fields, Bank/MFS transaction references, and disbursement contexts are encrypted at rest and linked in a tamper-evident hash chain.
about.p4Desc: Qard Hasan loans and Halal investments require a two-thirds member majority; charter amendments require 2/3 Shura plus 1/2 member quorum.
about.p5Desc: Tracks ৳5,000 monthly savings due by the 10th, isolates ৳50 late fees for annual January Sadaqah distribution, and syncs live to Google Sheets.

footer.description: Encrypted 20-member cooperative fund for interest-free Qard Hasan lending and 2/3-voted Halal ventures.
